lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੂਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aagai hee te sabh kichh hooaa avar k jaanai giaanaa ||
lines.translation: Everything is pre-ordained; what else can be known through study?

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhool chook apanaa baarik bakhasiaa paarabraham bhagavaanaa ||1||
lines.translation: The errant child has been forgiven by the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur meraa sadaa daiaalaa mohi deen kau raakh leeaa ||
lines.translation: My True Guru is always merciful; He has saved me, the meek one.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਟਿਆ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaatiaa rog mahaa sukh paaiaa har a(n)mrit mukh naam deeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He has cured me of my disease, and I have obtained the greatest peace; He has placed the Ambrosial Name of the Lord in my mouth. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪਾਪ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik paap mere parahariaa ba(n)dhan kaate mukat bhae ||
lines.translation: He has washed away my countless sins; He has cut away my bonds, and I am liberated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਾ ਘੋਰ ਤੇ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dh koop mahaa ghor te baah pakar gur kaadh leee ||2||
lines.translation: He has taken me by the arm, and pulled me out of the terrible, deep dark pit. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਰਾਖੇ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: nirabhau bhae sagal bhau mitiaa raakhe raakhanahaare ||
lines.translation: I have become fearless, and all my fears have been erased. The Savior Lord has saved me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aisee daat teree prabh mere kaaraj sagal savaare ||3||
lines.translation: Such is Your generosity, O my God, that You have resolved all my affairs. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun nidhaan saahib man melaa ||
lines.translation: My mind has met with my Lord and Master, the treasure of excellence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੪॥੯॥੪੮॥
lines.transliteration: saran paiaa naanak souhelaa ||4||9||48||
lines.translation: Taking to His Sanctuary, Nanak has become blissful. ||4||9||48||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਗੂ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) visarahi taa(n) sabh ko laagoo cheet aavahi taa(n) sevaa ||
lines.translation: If I forget You, then everyone becomes my enemy. When You come to mind, then they serve me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਦੂਜਾ ਸੂਝੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: avar na kooo doojaa soojhai saache alakh abhevaa ||1||
lines.translation: I do not know any other at all, O True, Invisible, Inscrutable Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਲੋਗਨ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: cheet aavai taa(n) sadaa daiaalaa logan kiaa vechaare ||
lines.translation: When You come to mind, You are always merciful to me; what can the poor people do to me?

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: buraa bhalaa kahu kis no kaheeai sagale jee tumhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Tell me, who should I call good or bad, since all beings are Yours? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰਾ ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: teree tek teraa aadhaaraa haath dei too(n) raakhahi ||
lines.translation: You are my Shelter, You are my Support; giving me Your hand, You protect me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਿਪੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਭਾਖੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jis jan oopar teree kirapaa tis kau bip na kooo bhaakhai ||2||
lines.translation: That humble being, upon whom You bestow Your Grace, is not touched by slander or suffering. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਓਹਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: oho sukh ohaa vadiaaee jo prabh jee man bhaanee ||
lines.translation: That is peace, and that is greatness, which is pleasing to the mind of the Dear Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਦ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) daanaa too(n) sad miharavaanaa naam milai ra(n)g maanee ||3||
lines.translation: You are all-knowing, You are forever compassionate; obtaining Your Name, I revel in it and make merry. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh aagai aradaas hamaaree jeeu pi(n)d sabh teraa ||
lines.translation: I offer my prayer to You; my body and soul are all Yours.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੯॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak sabh teree vadiaaee koee naau na jaanai meraa ||4||10||49||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, this is all Your greatness; no one even knows my name. ||4||10||49||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh a(n)tarajaamee saadhasa(n)g har paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Show Your Mercy, O God, O Searcher of hearts, that in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I might obtain You, Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਲਿ ਕਿਵਾਰ ਦਿਖਾਲੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: khol kivaar dikhaale darasan punarap janam na aaeeai ||1||
lines.translation: When You open Your Door, and reveal the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, the mortal is not relegated to reincarnation again. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਉ ਪਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਹਰਉ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: milau pareetam suaamee apune sagale dookh harau re ||
lines.translation: Meeting with my Beloved Lord aand Master, all my pains are taken away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿਨੑਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham jinhi ridai araadhiaa taa kai sa(n)g tarau re ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am saved and carried across, in the company of those who remember the Supreme Lord God in their hearts. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਪਾਵਕ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਏ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa udiaan paavak saagar bhae harakh sog mahi basanaa ||
lines.translation: This world is a great wilderness, an ocean of fire, in which mortals abide, in pleasure and pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਪਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: satigur bhet bhaiaa man niramal jap a(n)mrit har rasanaa ||2||
lines.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, the mortal becomes immaculately pure; with his tongue, he chants the Ambrosial Name of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਕੀਓ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੋਮਲ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan dhan thaap keeo sabh apanaa komal ba(n)dhan baa(n)dhiaa ||
lines.translation: He preserves his body and wealth, and takes everything as his own; such are the subtle bonds which bind him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaad bhae jan mukate har har naam araadhiaa ||3||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, the mortal becomes liberated, meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raakh leee prabh raakhanahaarai jo prabh apune bhaane ||
lines.translation: God, the Savior, has saved those, who are pleasing to the Will of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਦਾਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੫੦॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh tumhraa daate naanak sad kurabaane ||4||11||50||
lines.translation: The soul and body are all Yours, O Great Giver; O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice. ||4||11||50||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਲਨ ਨੀਦ ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕੀ ਕਉਨੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਭਇਓ ਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: moh malan need te chhutakee kaun anugrahu bhaio ree ||
lines.translation: You have avoided the slumber of attachment and impurity - by whose favor has this happened?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਗਇਓ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa mohanee tudh na viaapai teraa aalas kahaa gaio ree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The great enticer does not affect you. Where has your laziness gone? ||1||Pause||
